task.description: Tom Becker (tom@quickfit-gyms.com) asks for immediate help: the website chatbot has shown “Something went wrong” for every message since the morning of October 12. reply.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for flagging this. I understand the chatbot is failing for every message during today's promo. I can start investigating [start time] and will update you [update time].

Alex
